messages:
Maya Lin: quick heads-up : a processing delay hit onboarding imports created between 08:10-08:40 UTC. Need a short external note + AM escalation list. Keep it brief.
Ethan Brooks: I'll draft. Include current status, ETA to clear backlog, a clear manual retry step, and a goodwill gesture — keep it 2 short paras.
Ravi Patel: Manual retry: Console > Imports > Retry or API: `POST /v1/imports/:id/retry`. Logs show a queueing delay, not deletion.
Claire Sun: Suggest offering a priority onboarding session for impacted customers instead of the usual trial—call it a "priority integration review" and include a direct scheduler link. Also flag renewal-risk accounts for AM outreach.
accounting-bot: billing-bot: queued credit: provisional entry created for affected tenants; will post after confirmation.
Ethan Brooks: Draft: `Hi , we detected a short processing delay affecting new onboarding imports created 08:10-08:40 UTC. Engineers deployed a patch and backlog processing is underway; we expect catch-up within ~3 hours. To access newly ingested data sooner, trigger a manual retry in Console > Imports > Retry or call the retry API. No customer data was exposed or altered. As a courtesy we'll apply a prorated onboarding credit and offer a complimentary priority integration review to help validate your setup. To opt in reply "review" or book: https://schedule.redwood.ai/integration-review. For urgent help email cs@redwood.ai.`
Maya Lin: Good. Change "prorated onboarding credit" to "pro-rated onboarding credit applied to your next invoice" and add a one-question feedback link after send: https://tiny.redwood.com/onboard-feedback (Yes/No).
Ravi Patel: Engineering update: patch rolled at 08:55 UTC; backlog processing rate increased 2.8x. Projection: full catch-up by 11:15 UTC. I'll confirm when credits are posted.
Ethan Brooks: Sending now to Intercom for affected segment. I'll paste Intercom id and copy here when live.
Maya Lin: Owners: Ethan outbound & Intercom, Claire AM flags & scheduler, Ravi confirm credits. Close after credits posted + feedback summary. Thanks team :pray:
